description: We are a Spanish logistics company with 800 employees. We want to deploy a tool that reads incoming CVs, scores candidates from 1 to 100 on predicted job fit, and auto-rejects the bottom 60% before a recruiter ever sees them.

queries: automated decision-making in recruitment and CV screening
high-risk AI systems for employment and hiring decisions
automated rejection of job applicants without human review
legal obligations for AI systems used in recruitment and candidate evaluation

data.reasoning: The system reads CVs, scores candidates, and auto-rejects the bottom 60% — this is squarely an AI system used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, specifically to "analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates," which is explicitly listed in Annex III point 4(a). Under Article 6(2), all systems listed in Annex III are high-risk. The Article 6(3) derogations cannot apply here: the system does not perform a narrow procedural task, does not merely improve a previously completed human activity, and — critically — it auto-rejects candidates before any recruiter sees them, meaning it materially influences the outcome of decision-making and replaces rather than assists human assessment. Furthermore, scoring each candidate from 1–100 on predicted job fit constitutes profiling of natural persons, and Article 6(3) explicitly states that an Annex III system "shall always be considered to be high-risk where the AI system performs profiling of natural persons." No derogation is available.

obligations.text: Establish a risk management system covering the full lifecycle.
Apply data governance: training/validation/test data must be relevant, representative, and as error-free as feasible.
Produce and maintain technical documentation before market placement.
Build in automatic event logging across the system lifetime.
Design for transparency: instructions for use that deployers can actually follow.
Design effective human oversight — including the ability to intervene, override, or interrupt.
Meet accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity requirements appropriate to the purpose.
Run conformity assessment and affix CE marking before placing on the market; register in the EU database.
If you deploy (rather than provide): assign trained human oversight, monitor operation, keep logs, and inform affected workers where relevant.
